section_summary.extract_value: This discussion reports a single study finding that greater endorsement of traditional femininity ideology was modestly associated with lower body appreciation, including negative correlations with Total Traditional scores and two FIS subscales (Purity; Stereotypic Images and Activities). The authors note the associations were weak (femininity ideology and demographics explained 10.0% of variance), that the sample consisted of undergraduates (limiting generalisability), and that the correlational design prevents causal inference; they recommend further research on femininity ideology in body-image outcomes.
